title: Paleo Extension
description: STAC Paleo Extension for STAC Items: geological time for paleoclimate simulations, mirroring STAC core Date and Time with unbounded (deep-time) years. Values are ISO-8601-like strings parsed by the paleodatetime library.

paleo:datetime.title: Geological datetime
paleo:datetime.description: Nominal geological time the run represents, as an ISO-8601-like string with an unbounded (optionally negative) year, e.g. '-21000-01-01T00:00:00' for the Last Glacial Maximum. Parse with the paleodatetime library. May be null when a range is given via paleo:start_datetime/paleo:end_datetime.

paleo:start_datetime.title: Geological start datetime
paleo:start_datetime.description: Start of a transient run's geological span (paired with paleo:end_datetime), same string form as paleo:datetime.

paleo:end_datetime.title: Geological end datetime
paleo:end_datetime.description: End of a transient run's geological span (paired with paleo:start_datetime), same string form as paleo:datetime.
